# Azure AI Gateway — Govern Your AI Models

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's guide to turning Azure API Management (APIM) into an AI gateway in front of your models, MCP tools and agents: add Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry backends, then layer governance policies in the right order — authentication, semantic cache lookup (60–80% cost savings on repeated prompts), token limits, content safety and jailbreak detection, load balancing across backends, and token-usage metrics — plus MCP/tool rate limiting and converting APIs to MCP. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: APIM itself bills by the hour even when idle, so pick the tier deliberately; semantic-cache hit rates depend on tuning the score threshold.
